tree:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: portrait desktop wallpaper, 9:16 aspect ratio, ideally 2160x3840.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target: match the delicate loose graphite sketch of its sleeping cat, light pressure, visible pencil strokes, soft hatching and tender hand-drawn character.
Primary request: a small botanical tree in colored pencil on warm bone ivory paper (#f0ede7), as a companion wallpaper to this cat. A graceful young tree with a slim graphite and muted warm brown trunk, rounded airy foliage drawn with soft sage and olive green colored-pencil strokes, a few very subtle dusty pink accents (#e2a4ba). It must be unmistakably pencil drawing, NOT watercolor, NOT vector, NOT photorealistic.
Composition: vertical portrait page; tree occupies only the lower 30 percent of the page, around x 60 percent with generous margins, canopy about 45 percent page width. Upper 65 percent and center stay largely blank for terminal windows. No cat on this tree wallpaper.
Materials: extremely faint fine paper tooth, subtle warm ivory tonal variation, quiet center. Delicate drawing remains readable through a translucent terminal. Keep overall background uniform in hue, no vignette or cast shadow.
Constraints: single tree only, no pot, no landscape, no typography, no frame, no watermark. Calm understated color, no saturated greens.
cat:

Asset type: landscape desktop wallpaper, 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 3840x2160.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the sleeping cat's identity, pose, sketch style, small size and lower-right placement, and preserve the largely empty composition exactly. Make only these refinements: replace the peach heart outline with soft dusty pink #e2a4ba, very faint matching cheek blush; add almost imperceptible fine paper tooth to the warm ivory #f0ede7 background, with the center especially quiet. Keep graphite lines soft and hand drawn. No extra objects, no text, no frame, no new shadows, no vignette. Cat still occupies only approximately the lower-right 14 percent of page width.

Keep the identical warm #f0ede7 hue, near-invisible fine paper tooth and overall illumination. Output a portrait 9:16 blank companion wallpaper.
